why: Brief 9 section 5 asks for official and open sources with licences, and the earlier source notes on disk recorded hosts as unreachable from this container. Network routing here has changed at least once, so every host was retested rather than inherited. One of those notes was wrong today, and it was the one holding the climate surface at 267 cities.

tested.grain: any coordinate, 7 parameters x 12 months, 2001-2020 normals
tested.previous_note_on_disk: fetched through a browser because the sandbox has no network route to the host
tested.verdict: MATERIALISING. The climate families were data-limited, not demand-limited: 267 cities had data against 31,715 in the gazetteer.
tested.scale_if_fully_materialised: 31,715 cities x 12 months, before any demand or usefulness gate

tested.licence: Eurostat open data, free reuse with attribution
tested.verdict: CANDIDATE. Feeds the COUNTRY to REGION level of the hierarchy for the six EU markets with real regional figures rather than a name and a map.
tested.scale_estimate: about 1,500 NUTS2 and NUTS3 regions across DE FR IT ES NL PL

tested.status: HTTP 200, 12.7 MB, usable without a key
tested.grain: every airport on earth with coordinates, type, municipality, scheduled service flag
tested.verdict: CANDIDATE. The parent for an airport complex, and the entity for getting-there pages. Only the scheduled-service subset is page-worthy.
tested.scale_estimate: roughly 4,000 to 5,000 airports with scheduled service worldwide

tested.status: HTTP 200, 2.6 MB, usable without a key
tested.licence: catalogue CC0; each feed carries its own operator licence, which has to be read per feed
tested.grain: one row per transit feed, with the operator, the area and the feed URL
tested.verdict: CANDIDATE for the transport surface. Static GTFS gives counts of lines, stops and operators, which are facts. It does NOT give live schedules and will not be used to imply any.
tested.scale_estimate: about 1,500 cities with a usable feed

tested.verdict: WEAK for scale: country grain only, and country pages are already the smallest part of the inventory. Useful as a corroborating field, not as a page family.

tested.status: HTTP 401, an API key is required
tested.licence: CC BY 4.0 for most providers, per-provider
tested.verdict: BLOCKED on registration, not on routing. Recorded so the next pass does not retest the route and conclude the source does not exist.

tested.licence: WDPA terms, non-commercial restrictions that would need reading before use
tested.verdict: NOT PURSUED. The protected-area parents are already coming from OSM, which carries the same polygons under ODbL and no token, and the WDPA terms are the kind that need legal reading rather than a gate.
